about: One visual grammar for claim chips (README to video, receipts, briefs). Source of truth: scripts/grammar_chips_emit.py writes src/ui/grammarChipTokens.ts and the CSS block in src/ui-kit/grammar-chips/chips.html from this file. Values come from DESIGN.md (dark: obsidian world; light: Light paper world, every signal at least 4.6:1 on #e9eef4). Dark mode reads the kit tokens (src/ui-kit/recoil-report/_tokens.css, inlined verbatim into the HTML) by name; the hex values here mirror them for JSX.

show.meaning: shown: the record is on the page

request.meaning: the record exists and is private; shown on request

notyet.meaning: not yet shown, admitted (the honesty tilde)

limit.meaning: the caveat that travels with the claim

fail.meaning: a check that did not pass

rules: Status glyphs follow /proof (public/proof.html), decided by Zach 2026-10-30 (option A): ▲ shown green, ◆ on request cyan, ~ not yet gold. No other tone may reuse those three glyphs.
Color is never the only cue: every tone carries its glyph and its tag.

Fidelity sets the body text weight and tracking (the WORLD.md render scale); the mono tag holds at 700. Text stays at full opacity at every fidelity; fog shows through weight, tracking and texture (WORLD.md, 2026-10-11).
A claim strip that holds a SAY chip and no LIMIT chip, where the source has a caveat, renders the FAIL state (rule R5).
Signal color tints border, tag and glyph only; the body text stays in the mode's text color.
Depth: HUD by default (hairline and corner ticks, no glow, no cast shadow). The field and pocket skins add inset light for surfaces that want hardware feel; never a cast drop shadow.

led.about: A slow underlit LED in the glyph, like a hardware status light. Only data-live chips pulse. The pulse moves glow radius, not opacity, over 2x --dur-sweep (3s per breath, well under --mo-flash-max), and stops under reduced motion.

skins.about: Skins change material, never tone meaning, glyphs or tags. 'hud' is the default (Zach, 2026-10-30: tactical HUD, Porsche Design restraint over web 2.0 glow): matte face, neutral hairline, corner ticks in the tone, a tag divider, tabular numbers, no glow and no cast shadow; live = a 1px hairline sweep along the bottom edge (position only). 'field' (opt-in): recessed well, underlit tone, breathing LED. 'pocket' (opt-in): the dj.arcs.care Pocket skin.
